messages:
micah: Heads-up — docs smoke test failing for the Optimize Toolkit examples on CI. It looks like the streaming SDK snippet in 'batching + kv prefetch' got stale after the api surface change. Error in logs: "TypeError: client.stream is not a function".

micah: PR to fix would be a small snippet change + an e2e repro test. Assigning to docs owners first. Any objections to a quick patch?

sasha: Not an objection. I can take the snippet change. Where should the e2e live? docs repo or examples repo?

micah: examples repo preferred — we already run the examples smoke job there. Keep the docs change minimal: update code block & link to the example. Also add a short comment explaining why streaming is recommended for long sequences.

jordan: Thanks for flagging. The new SDK call is client.responses.stream or client.responses.streamGenerate depending on language. For JS snippet keep it tiny: show streaming usage + hint to enable kv prefetch via opts.cachePrefetch = true.

sasha: Copy — I'll update JS and Python snippets. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/examples/pull/235 (WIP). Will include: 1) replace old `client.stream.generate` with `client.responses.streamGenerate`, 2) add a one-liner explaining batch window tradeoffs, 3) link to console docs for quant profiles.

lee: Quick note — please ensure the snippet still builds with our minimal test harness (no auth). The examples CI uses a mocked client for offline smoke checks. If the new call surface requires a stream object, mock harness needs tiny update.

sasha: Good call. I'll add a small adapter in examples/test/mocks to expose `responses.streamGenerate` in the mock client.

micah: Also add a short test that runs the snippet with cachePrefetch on and asserts the request included `cache_prefetch: true` in the payload. That's enough to keep coverage up.

jordan: Suggestion: add an explanatory comment in the docs near the snippet about when to prefer streaming vs sync for throughput/latency (2–3 bullets). Otherwise folks copy/paste without understanding batching windows.

sasha: Will add bullets. Example bullets: - streaming for long-running outputs reduces memory, - streaming + kv prefetch improves token reuse for repeated prefixes, - sync calls are OK for <128 tokens.

micah: Nice. Once PR is ready, I'll post in #eng-releases for a quick review + merge window. Also tag @docbot to run the docs link-checker after merge.

docbot: Incoming check scheduled: link-check -> examples PR 235 after merge.

sasha: PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/examples/pull/235 — ready for review. Includes mock adapter, updated JS/Python snippets, and a tiny mocha test that asserts cache flag.

lee: Reviewing now. Quick nit: rename `cachePrefetch` to `kvPrefetch` in the snippet to match current SDK naming. I'll leave an inline comment on the PR.

sasha: Good catch, changed locally and pushed.

deploy-bot: CI: examples-smoke (includes snippet-runner) started for sha abc123.

micah: Post-merge checklist: 1) update docs page to point to the example permalink, 2) run website build on preview, 3) close the docs issue tracking the stale snippet. I'll take steps 1+2 once PR merges.

deploy-bot: CI: examples-smoke passed for sha abc123.

sasha: Merged. Linking to docs PR in a follow-up: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/412 (WIP).

micah: Thank you — this resolves the flaky job. Leaving this thread to track the follow-up docs PR. If anyone runs into a similar TypeError, point them here. :thumbsup:
